capturas-tutorial-formula100k 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a skill to generate tutorial-style UI captures (terminal, step cards, callouts, screenshot frames, keyboard shortcuts, etc.) in the F100K visual style.
- Renders assets via HTML + CSS + Puppeteer (no AI used), outputting high-quality PNGs (1920×1080, transparent or cream background).
- Supports two modes: STANDALONE (single PNGs) and BATCH (manifest-driven).
- Strict rules for when to use each type of capture and “pure mode” operation for consistent overlays.
- Includes detailed instructions for setup and usage in OpenClaw, handling dependencies, font loading, and capture delivery.
- Specifies all supported asset types and provides clear visual design tokens.
